summary: PR #1 (mono) merged, CI and CD green: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0, inlined at build so no registry release); core-shell passes owner 'platform', billing 'payments' (from package.json team). Also fixed sub-route-reports (owner 'insights'), which calls validateApp and would have broken at startup though not in the ticket. PLAT-103-4 (platform-kit): no change made. It has no validateApp call and no dependency on shared-contracts (which is an in-repo inlined lib, not a registry package), so there is nothing to pass or adopt; no new release published. Assumptions: owner is a non-empty string after trim; billing needs no platform-kit bump.
